用键盘调整宽 / 高: Resize width or height with the keyboard
连续多选样式: Select a continuous range of styles
评论中编号列表: Create a numbered list in a comment
序列开头/结尾: Go to sequence start or end
转到入点/出点: Go to In or Out point
移到首项/末项: Go to first or last item
将色标放到 0%–100% 对应位置: Move color stop to the corresponding 0%–100% position
将色标放在相邻两个色标正中间: Center a color stop between adjacent stops
接受内联建议/下一编辑建议: Accept inline suggestion or next edit suggestion
从输入框转到结果: Move focus from input to results
从结果返回输入框: Move focus from results to input
下一处查找结果: Go to the next search result
上一处查找结果: Go to the previous search result
定位到页、书签、脚注等: Go to a page, bookmark, footnote, or other location
行首/行尾: Go to the start or end of the line
上一段/下一段: Go to the previous or next paragraph
返回最近编辑位置: Return to the most recent edit location
行首/行尾的硬件替代键: Hardware-key alternative for line start or end
扩展到行首/行尾: Extend selection to the start or end of the line
增大 1 磅: Increase font size by one point
上一查找结果: Go to the previous search result
上一行 / 下一行: Move to the previous or next row
移至批注开头/结尾: Move to the start or end of a comment
在审阅窗格中移至批注列表开头/结尾: Move to the start or end of the comment list in the Reviewing pane
下一域 / 上一域: Go to the next or previous field
拼写和语法 / 同义词库: Check spelling and grammar or open the thesaurus
下一控件 / 上一控件: Move to the next or previous control
下一/上一控件: Move to the next or previous control
到行首: Go to the start of the row
到工作表开头: Go to the beginning of the worksheet
到最后已使用单元格: Go to the last used cell
单元格内换行: Insert a line break in a cell
展开 / 折叠公式栏: Expand or collapse the formula bar
重查依赖并完整计算: Recheck dependencies and calculate all formulas
扩展到行首: Extend selection to the start of the row
扩展到工作表开头: Extend selection to the beginning of the worksheet
扩展到最后已使用单元格: Extend selection to the last used cell
仅保留活动单元格: Keep only the active cell selected
拼写 / 同义词库: Check spelling or open the thesaurus
下一张/上一张幻灯片: Go to the next or previous slide
置于底层/顶层: Send to Back or Bring to Front
上/下一行: Move up or down one line
上/下一段: Move to the previous or next paragraph
下一/上一单元格: Move to the next or previous cell
下一/上一行: Move to the next or previous row
下一动画/下一张: Play the next animation or go to the next slide
上一动画/上一张: Play the previous animation or go to the previous slide
第一张 / 最后一张: Go to the first or last slide
备注窗格中移到下一控件: Move to the next control in the Notes pane
